comments.value: Or you introduce 18+ lobby options for all instance types

No, this kann be abused to get a persons exact birthday.

When the Status for example switches from Verified to 18

@{640c76efcced024514ae4d6a|full_name} this function is already available on the website, I am interested in the status Hidden, Verified and Verified 18+ or you introduce verified lobbies for all instance types

@{5f293f21f7553f5a9ad29221|full_name} I don't understand what you mean.

You want the ability to read the hidden age verification status of a user?

@{640c76efcced024514ae4d6a|full_name} No, definitely not, I just want to be able to access the status that you see on the VRC page via udon.

We have to see what the VRC team has planned for the future but 18+ only for groups is semi optimal

18+ for all instance types would also take care of my request

@{5f293f21f7553f5a9ad29221|full_name} Still, you can use this determine a users real age, so this might a privacy violation.

Since 18+ lobbies are a thing, there's no need for this.

@{640c76efcced024514ae4d6a|full_name} I think you misunderstand me, so far there is only for groups this option not for all other instance types and currently it is not really good to manage events (we are talking about an invite only lobby)

I currently have to look at each user profile individually to check whether 18+ or not, which is extremely time-consuming to simplify this, there are two possibilities: either you set 18+ for all instance types or you give the world creators the opportunity to make the status that you can already see on the website available in game!!!!

@{5f293f21f7553f5a9ad29221|full_name} Then make just host a Group instance?

The missuse and abuse potential is way to huge.

No profile information, private or public, should ever be readable via UDON or its successor.

@{640c76efcced024514ae4d6a|full_name} then the status should not be readable via the website either!!!

Group instances are not an option as we do not have the possibility to change the group rights at runtime

but I agree with you the data should not be readable so 18+ must be introduced for all instances

@{5f293f21f7553f5a9ad29221|full_name} there is a difference if you show it in your profile, or you read the profile via script.

The first is the users choice, the second is a privacy violation.

Further up you mentioned: "(we are talking about an invite only lobby)".

Why is there the need then anyways? this makes totally no sense. If you invite the users, then you might already checked them beforehand?

@{640c76efcced024514ae4d6a|full_name} api scapers like vrcx can also read this data and log it, or you could simply check manually every day. the privacy concern would be with displaying "age verified" and "verified 18+" separately in the first place.

Sorry, abuse potential? How? Where?

If a user publicly displays they are 18+ verified in their profile, a simple isAgeVerified bool on the VRCPlayerAPI object to be true is all anyone needs or is asking for here.

If a user is verified but under 18, on their birthday just turn their status to hidden. User has plausible deniability at that point.

Aside from that, its just a birthday. Verified users without the 18+ tag but still visibly verified are already advertising to the world they're a minor. Don't you think that's a slightly bigger problem than someone noticing 'hey friend, you were verified yesterday but verified 18+ today, wow it must be your birthday'..

C'mon now..

While the vrc team distributes wave after wave of bans, they haven't given this important suggestion the time of day. But the main thing is to upload great statement videos to YouTube.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PQaeFS0Wfr8

details: For better management of invite-only instances, it would be desirable to integrate an Player API call for UDON so that one could query the status of the age verification and have it displayed on a tablet, for example.
title: Status of age verification via UDON
